name: MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv_rename
source:
theorem hasseDeriv_rename {τ : Type*} {f : σ → τ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (d : σ →₀ ℕ)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    hasseDeriv (d.mapDomain f) (rename f P) = rename f (hasseDeriv d P) := by
  classical
  induction P using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial k a =>
    simp [rename_monomial, hasseCoeff, Finsupp.prod_mapDomain_index_inj hf,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective hf, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_tsub hf]
  | add p q hp hq => simp [hp, hq]

what: Injectively renaming variables commutes with differentiation when the multi-index is transported by the same renaming.
how: Additive monomial induction uses Finsupp.prod_mapDomain_index_inj for the binomial factors and Finsupp.mapDomain_tsub for the lowered exponent; rename_monomial transports the monomial.
hypotheses: Commutative coefficients and an injective variable map; injectivity prevents collisions between differentiation coordinates.
